method: every memory item's text is folded (NFKC, casefold, punctuation/symbol/space removed) and matched any-of against the question's expect tokens - the same match the harness uses for a hit; a question with zero containing items is a guaranteed miss and measures coverage, not retrieval. Specificity is measured per expected token; because the match is any-of, the MOST common token decides the false-hit risk, so `max_token_items` classifies the question and `low_specificity_ids` must be excluded from the gate verdict.
